name: Acceptance Layout Mover
description: The acceptance run's plugin that is not the bot's and rearranges bots' tabs (the owner's "move a button" question). On a bot with no layout of its own it moves ONE top-bar button, the editor's (`chrome.action` keyed `edit`), to just above the composer and nudges it a few pixels with its own CSS (and takes the conversation out, so the run proves the way back). On a bot with a layout it moves the bot's header bar there instead. It adds two buttons to that header (Wave and Pin); the bot's own plugin hides Pin.
